name: Blue Marble: Next Generation, September 2004 base map
credit: NASA Earth Observatory; Reto Stöckli, Eric Vermote, Nazmi Saleous, Robert Simmon and David Herring (2005)
license: NASA imagery usage guidelines; no third-party copyright notice on this dataset
projection: Plate Carree, WGS84; rows north to south, columns west to east
processing: Original JPEG bytes unchanged. At runtime geographic UVs drape the image on the Equal Earth terrain; local surface texture and political color are blended by the material.
limitations: Modern September 2004 land cover is geographic background color, not a reconstruction of 1922/1936 land use or live seasonal snow. Nominal 8 km pixels do not supply harbor scenery. Terrain elevation and campaign land boundaries come from separate datasets. NASA does not endorse this game.
